_doc: Train definitions for tools/t0/build.py (see tools/t0/README.md). Trains are cumulative: a group whose 'first' train is X applies to X and every later train. Bundle groups always apply in 'group_order'.

R0.what: R0-intro-delete (perf-cwv-04); the rename/loader/SW mechanism itself is code, not a group

A.what: crash and input: C5 calls, sound, pointer capture, monuments loop, keys, storage, attribution, D-HEATMAP removals

B.what: clock and data: date +2, day loading on jump, merge fix, stateless i2, minimap

C.what: mobile shell (53 bundle patches + 3 index.html rows); must precede AX

AX.what: a11y bridge (13 bundle patches); must follow C (G-close-mobile expects 3 hits)

CP.what: truthful-copy subset (16 bundle rows + 2 Help rows)

R0.what: mechanism: hashed names, boot loader, no-reload SW, kill switch, version.json, intro deletion

R1a.what: R0 + group A + page groups (PG-*) + assets overlay

R1c.what: R1b + B + DL + CP + generated config (headers/redirects)

known_overlaps.resolution: C applies first; the a11y row then expects 3 hits instead of 4 (chapter 02 section 7)
